author: Wahiz
body:
IGN: surnames
Discord( Name#): Canads#8922
Timezone: EST+1
Any previous Ref experience? No, but I am currently official on another network :)
Why would you like to join the referee team: I want to get more involved with the competitive community and I feel this would be a good way for me to get more involved!
Are you able to commit to Saturday Tournaments, and occasionally event staff meetings? Yes, I'm free every Saturday and most nights during the week. Sunday is tricky because I don't get home until 2pm my time.
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself:
Anything else?: 

I am an active member of the community (not in the discords, but can be), I'm hard working and will do anything to get the job at hand done. I work well as a team, and get along with most people ;p
